description: This file defines the SerializationService interface in Java, which specifies methods for obtaining serializers, serializing objects, and deserializing data within the OpenMRS platform. It includes method signatures and documentation but no implementations.

classes.name: SerializationService
classes.description: An interface providing methods for serialization and deserialization of objects in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getDefaultSerializer
methods.description: Returns the default serializer configured for the system.

methods.name: getSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves a serializer that matches the specified class.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object into a string using a specified serializer class.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into an object using the specified serializer class, with appropriate annotations for logging and authorization.

methods.name: getSerializers
methods.description: Returns a list of all serializers registered with this service.
